name: Calculator Standard
description: Declarative quality standard for future calculator assets.

entryExperience: complete hero with value promise and output preview
formJourney: guided classes include context and proportional progression
resultExperience: primary result is distinguishable from secondary metrics
meaning and scenario context are understandable without returning to form
class-required interpretation, limitations and next steps are present
calculationMemory: non-trivial reports include inputs, premises, intermediates, operations, rounding, final result and limitations
memory and primary result are equivalent
content: content depth is proportional to intent and risk
FAQ is sufficient and matches FAQPage when used
actions: copy, print and report applicability evaluated
recommendations: rendering requires approved source and eligibility
visual: structural, design-system, quality and responsive parity assessed
small mobile, large mobile, intermediate and desktop evidence resolved
focus, error, empty and overflow states reviewed

fullStandardBlockers: false visual pass without rendered evidence
migrationNotes: Assets on v1.0 may migrate to v1.1 for improved evidence requirements.
Assets on v1.x may migrate to v2.0 only through Migration, Testing and Validation gates.

availableVersions.1.1: Canonical reference-backed experience, result, memory, visual evidence and anti-pattern enforcement.
availableVersions.2.0: Reserved for future layout, publishing and monetization quality changes.
